cohort: 100 neonates with meconium aspiration syndrome (MAS) admitted to Services Hospital Lahore between January 1, 2021, and June 30, 2021, randomly divided into two groups: one treated with dexamethasone and one control group.
finding: The duration of both hospital stay and ventilation (invasive and non-invasive) were significantly reduced in the dexamethasone group compared to the control group.
followup_time: Duration of hospital stay (up to approximately 10 days)
